title: Before and After: Teaching Our Engine to Read Bad Scans
summary: We fed our engine the worst scans we could find. It invented 26 tables that didn't exist. Here's how we got that number to zero — and kept it there.
feed_summary: We fed our engine the worst scans we could find. It invented 26 tables that didn't exist. Here's how that number became zero, and stays there.
llms_blurb: How the engine went from inventing 26 phantom tables on noise pages to zero, the fabrication-never-buys-recall rule, and the conversion report that replaces silent page skips.
